messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the statutory holidays that created “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday falling on a weekday that gives you at least two consecutive days off) in Canada during 2023.  
(For brevity, I’ve grouped the holidays that apply nationwide and noted the provinces/territories where the holiday is observed.)

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if moved) | Day of Week | Where it’s a statutory holiday* |
|---|---------|-----------|----------------------|--------------|----------------------------------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sun) | Observed Mon Jan 2 | Sun | All provinces & territories |
| 2 | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Mon) | – | Mon | AB, SK, BC, ON, NB, PEI, NL, NT, YT |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | – | Fri | All provinces & territories |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | – | Mon | All provinces & territories |
| 5 | **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Sat) | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Sat | All provinces & territories |
| 6 | **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | – | Mon | All provinces & territories |
| 7 | **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | – | Mon | All provinces & territories |
| 8 | **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Fri) | – | Fri | All provinces & territories |

\*All provinces and territories listed under “Where it’s a statutory holiday” observe the holiday as a paid day off. Some provinces (e.g., Quebec) do not observe Family Day, but the rest of the list applies nationwide.

### How to use this in your app

If you’re building a calendar or scheduling feature, you can hard‑code these dates (or pull them from a reliable API such as the Government of Canada’s public‑holiday service) and flag them as “public holiday.” When a holiday falls on a weekday, automatically extend the weekend by marking the adjacent weekend days as part of a “long weekend” block.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same data broken down by individual province or if you need help integrating it into a specific framework!
